text:
elaine: Heads-up from vault-audit: a partner namespace shows repeated lease renewals beyond configured TTL (policy partner-short). Seen since 2026-04-25 02:00UTC. Pointing @sam @naveen for triage. Link: https://internal/alerts/lease-ttl-anom-3759999000

sam: grabbing logs. Quick grep shows renovver job `partner-lease-watcher` ran with a new image yesterday and started renewing leases without checking TTL. Possible bug in rollout.

naveen: Can we pause the job and snapshot current leases? I'll also enable debug audit and export current ciphertext metadata.

elaine: Pause it. Command: `kubectl scale deploy/partner-lease-watcher -n infra 0`

sam: paused. Exported leases: s3://redwood-audit/exports/lease-anom-3759999000.json

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-3759999000-lease-ttl. PagerDuty notified.

naveen: Suggest immediate containment: 1) revoke long-lived leases, 2) rotate KMS primary version and rewrap affected ciphertexts, 3) add temporary RBAC restriction on implicated SA, 4) notify partner ops. Volunteers?

sam: I'll take revokes and throttle to avoid mass failures. Running: `vault lease revoke -prefix=partner/` and verifying with `vault list sys/leases/lookup` samples.

elaine: I'll prepare partner comms and draft the postmortem checklist. Add auto-revoke rule for renewed_after:TTL to postmortem action items.

naveen: KMS rewrap queued. Will run on isolated pool. Will also check s3 exports for any outward transfers.

sec-bot: Audit stream enabled: s3://redwood-audit/partner/3759999000-debug/

sam: Revokes started, currently 60/180 leases revoked. Throttling to 30/min. Some ingestion jobs 502ing; notifying infra leads.

elaine: Good. Keep updates here. Postmortem scheduled Fri 11am PT. Owners: sam (revokes), naveen (rewrap + scans), elaine (partner comms).
